_about: Stub bodies (x86-64, position independent), referenced by name from fixes.json. "ret:<value>" in a fix means mov eax, <value>; ret (ret0 when 0).

opmode_normal.asm: mov dword [rdi], 2; and dword [rsi], 0; xor eax, eax; ret
opmode_normal.note: int sceKernelGetOperationMode(int* mode, int* lowEnergy): *mode = 2; *lowEnergy = 0; return 0

flag0.asm: mov dword [rdi], 0; xor eax, eax; ret
flag0.note: out-parameter flag = 0 (sceNpEntitlementAccessGetGameTrialsFlag: not a trial): *rdi = 0; return 0

err_http2.note: return an error so the caller takes its 'unavailable' path (CONTROL's sceHttp2WebSocket* stubs)

opmode_pro.asm: mov dword [rdi], 3; and dword [rsi], 0; xor eax, eax; ret
opmode_pro.note: sceKernelGetOperationMode forcing PS5 Pro: *mode = 3; *lowEnergy = 0; return 0 (AC 4xx+, Yotei)

byte0.asm: mov byte [rdi], 0; xor eax, eax; ret

byte1.asm: mov byte [rdi], 1; xor eax, eax; ret
byte1.note: bool out-parameter = 1 (sceAgcGetIsTrinityMode forcing PS5 Pro, AC 4xx+): *(u8*)rdi = 1; return 0

out2_byte0.asm: mov byte [rsi], 0; xor eax, eax; ret
out2_byte0.note: second argument is a bool out-parameter = 0 (scePadIsRemoteController: not remote): *(u8*)rsi = 0; return 0

out2_zero50.asm: xor eax, eax; test rsi, rsi; je .ret; mov rdi, rsi; mov ecx, 0x50; rep stosb; .ret: ret
out2_zero50.note: second argument is a 0x50-byte output struct: zero it (when not null); return 0
